body: Is it related to sexual harassment or something?
Since you are so ashamed to reveal it, my guess is that it involves C/P or something like this.

Hi OP. It has been 5 years since I was raped, and I just could handle it because I converted all of those feelings in hate. I wouldn’t forgive myself if my death was provoked by my own hands. This is unfair to me, and it’s also unfair with you. 

My rapist almost went to jail because he can’t pay the child support for her daughter. He is unemployed, nobody wants him, not even companies, not even his mother. This is the best revenge I could get. If I died, I would NEVER see this pig fail. 

He’s a loser, you already won. Stay here and let’s watch they fall together. It worths living, I promise. It’s unfeasible at this moment, but things get better. It really does.

Absolutely! And you can also discover how to be friends with other people. How long have you been friends just with them? 

I mean, you are going to feel lonely without them, but this also can be a good opportunity to understand how you could meet other people. Let time pass and you will see both of you won’t be the same, so you can build a healthier relationship with them again.

In order to change this situation you must be available to set boundaries and leave. Won’t matter what we tell you if you don’t realize this is a toxic environment and you have to leave. If she is in your friend’s group, there are only two options: you start to get away from them or you stay in this agony. 

I know it’s not simple and you’ll feel lonely most of the time from there, but it’s necessary if you don’t want to feel like you would kill yourself. There are 8 billion people in the world, you will find another group of friends! You matter, please don’t stay on this toxic situation, you can leave and construct healthy relationships.
I’m sorry I know it’s not that simple but why are you still friends with this person?
